page.audience: Owner or dispatcher running a small HVAC company

page.subheadline: An AI Voice Assistant that answers when the crew is on a job, takes the details a quote needs, and keeps the callback moving.
page.situation: Calls arrive while technicians are on site.

disclosure.text: This page is shared by an independent iThinq AI Partner, who may be compensated if you become a customer.

sections.heading: Late afternoon, everyone is on a job
sections.body: The furnace call came in at 4:50pm and rang out

sections.heading: What a missed call costs
sections.body: Calls arrive while technicians are on site. Nobody is in the office to take the details. By the evening the job has been booked by whoever picked up first.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.body: Answers inbound calls. Takes the caller through the questions a quote needs. Hands the details back in a form the office can act on. Asks the same questions in the same order whoever is on shift. Answers calls outside opening hours, where your setup supports it. Does not replace the people who do the work.

sections.heading: This suits you if
items: Calls arrive while technicians are on site
Nobody is in the office to answer
Quotes depend on details taken over the phone
Callbacks slip until the end of the day

sections.heading: This is not for you if
items: You already have office cover that answers every call
You want emergency dispatch decisions made for you

qa.question: If they say it sounds too technical
qa.answer: From the caller's side it is an ordinary phone call, and nobody on your team has to learn a new system to get the message.

qa.question: If they say not right now
qa.answer: That is fair. The calls that ring out today are the ones worth looking at first.
